It belongs to the late canonical/post-canonical prose literature preserved in the Pali tradition, featuring the discussions between King Milinda and the elder Nāgasena [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral documents four translations across three modern languages, including an English translation by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].
